title: Block Out Level 12 Walkthrough
summary: Block Out Level 12 is a sandglass puzzle with two chambers joined by a narrow waist. Pass the long bars through the center throat in alternating order, keep both halves balanced, and use the temporary pockets for the cyan `2` bricks.

variants.gameVersion: current iOS and Android catalog checked 2026-08-03

boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 12 is a sandglass puzzle with two chambers joined by a narrow waist. Pass the long bars through the center throat in alternating order, keep both halves balanced, and use the temporary pockets for the cyan `2` bricks.
landmarks: Block Out Level 12 is a sandglass puzzle with two chambers joined by a narrow waist.
Pass the long bars through the center throat in alternating order, keep both halves balanced, and use the temporary pockets for the cyan `2` bricks.
The board mixes Blue, Red, Cyan and more.
The opening layout is a color-sort grid.
Clear matched tiles to finish the level.

quickTips: Every strong move either enters or clears the waist.
Move the paired cyan `2` bricks only after a long bar has crossed.
If the board feels stuck, look for the color with the cleanest path and use that to regain space.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Drop one of the center vertical bars through the narrow throat so the two chambers stop pinning each other.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Swap the top red and blue columns through the waist until one side counter shrinks enough to give extra room.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Move the paired cyan `2` bricks only after a long bar has crossed, so they use the temporary pocket instead of clogging it.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Keep alternating top-to-bottom and bottom-to-top transfers through the center until the outer yellow columns can separate cleanly.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Use the newly opened side lanes to remove the red columns from each chamber.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Finish by draining the last yellow and blue columns after the throat is no longer occupied.

failurePoints: Trying to clear one chamber completely before using the other half.
Parking a short block in the throat when a full column still needs to cross.
